actions.body: The analysis of existing cognitive architectures (e.g., source-db145486024f469a, source-f955850b0fcf467a) reveals that while there is extensive work categorizing architecture types (source-bda2bc47c38c47a2), explicit mechanisms for dynamic self-correction and autonomous error detection remain under-documented in comparative surveys. Most architectures rely on predefined constraints rather than internal self-monitoring protocols capable of identifying foundational reasoning limits.
actions.lede: This review synthesizes current literature on cognitive architectures, specifically examining how they handle self-correction and internal error detection versus the prevailing focus on structural surveys.
